Seerr.description:
Request management and media discovery tool for your Media Server (Plex/Emby/Jellyfin), integrating with Sonarr and Radarr.

Note: If you will use Seerr with Sonarr and Radarr, then make sure all of them are in the same Docker network after installation.

Based on a official OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture. Rockstor V5.5.0 or later.
